Last time my husband picked up one of the caregivers on the way, Sári got into the back seat and Rozi immediately sat on his lap and on that short trip Sári got about 100 kisses! My dog ​​Kanga has been going to Citypets for a few months. Since she is separated, she now goes to daycare every weekday. I struggled with the search for a long time because I wanted to find a place where she would be in good hands and where she would enjoy going. Kanga has several handicaps, which is why they wouldn't have wanted to take her elsewhere, but here they were positive about it and agreed to the trial day. Her career at the daycare hasn't been completely smooth since then, but the girls always communicate the problems and are extremely cooperative in finding solutions. Kanga goes in every morning happily crying, no matter who comes out to get her. It's clear that she cares about all the caregivers. It's very positive that the dogs don't have to work all day, but they also take the dogs in for a rest several times (avoiding overtiredness), and there is no set time within the opening hours when I can take Kanga in and out. Due to the separation, we are completely dependent on the daycare, but we feel completely safe here, for which I am grateful to the entire team! 🥰
Thank you very much! :)

When we travel, we leave our dog Mogyi, a mixed breed dog for 3 years, at the guesthouse. Before we found City Pets, he usually came home from every guesthouse stressed, dirty, smelly, and was angry with us for days for leaving him there.
The girls who take care of the dogs at CityPets are very sweet and remembered everything about Mogyi. The owner is also very kind and helpful and his problem-solving skills are remarkable. Thank you for that.
We know our dog is safe with them and it shows that they take care of him. We bring a happy, balanced dog from them. I also recommend the cosmetics wholeheartedly, although it may not look like we are getting Mogyi back, but he is very beautiful and well-groomed!
Thank you for your care!
